full_lines.heard: Flying into Jamaica's North Coast at Ian Fleming, here's how to reach your hotel.
The airport is in Bosco Bell, St. Mary, about 15 kilometers east of Ocho Rios.
The airport lists taxi or coach higher and taxis are available on site when needed for an extra fee.
or book a private transfer before you land, so your driver is arranged in advance.
Driving yourself, Jamaica drives on the left, so take it slowly on the coast road.
Compare partner transfers through the link in the description. If you book through our links, we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.

note: Proxy only: whisper base.en recognising the name does not prove natural pronunciation.
